name: Lunar Shuttle Veers Toward Terminal
description: The Lunar shuttle suddenly veers off course, hurtling uncontrollably toward the terminal. Alarms blare as it accelerates, its trajectory set for a direct collision with the structure.
related_events: Lunar shuttle veers out of control toward terminal

name: Passengers Directed to Concourse Lounge B for Lunar Departures
description: A voice over the public address system announces that all passengers with lunar departures should proceed to concourse lounge B. Travelers begin moving through the terminal, following the designated path toward the lounge.
related_events: Announcement directs lunar departures to concourse lounge B

name: Jet Fighter Accelerates Across the Sky
description: A jet fighter roars through the sky, accelerating rapidly as it streaks through the air at high speed.
related_events: Jet fighter accelerates through the sky

name: Crew Battles to Stabilize Ship Amid Violent Lurching
description: The ship heaved suddenly to one side, throwing the crew off their feet. They scrambled across the tilted deck, grabbing at rails and consoles to pull themselves upright. One sailor braced against the helm, fighting to correct the vessel's erratic motion. Others shouted warnings as loose equipment clattered across the floor. Together, they worked to steady the ship, adjusting controls and shifting weight to counter the violent swaying.
related_events: Crew struggles to regain control of the ship during violent motion

name: Striker Arrives in Palukaville
description: Striker's fighter aircraft descends through the clouds and touches down on a runway in South America. The engines wind down as the canopy opens, and Striker steps out onto the tarmac, surrounded by the dry landscape of Palukaville in 2002.
related_events: Striker's fighter lands in South America

name: Ted Gets Beer on Himself
description: Beer spills suddenly onto Ted's face and shirt. He reacts immediately, his expression and movements showing surprise and discomfort.
related_events: Ted gets beer on his face and shirt

name: Kruger Reports Press Scrutiny During Escalator Descent
description: Kruger and the Commissioner descend an escalator. As they move downward, Kruger tells the Commissioner that the press has been questioning people in his front office. He instructs the Commissioner to pass a message up the chain: the board should inform downtown, who in turn should alert Washington.
related_events: Kruger and Commissioner descend escalator
Kruger reports press investigation to Commissioner

name: The Plane Executes a Barrel Roll
description: The plane begins to roll around its longitudinal axis, tracing a helical path through the air. As it rotates, it maintains a controlled flight trajectory, completing a full barrel roll from upright to inverted and back to level flight.
related_events: Plane performs a barrel roll

name: Controller Confirms Shuttle Status During Tour
description: A group tours the control room, moving behind a row of controllers. The guide explains that all lunar shuttle landings are managed by computers and displayed on video units. At one station, a controller speaks into a headset, stating, 'You're programmed on R-two-niner and locked, Lunar eight six. Over.'
related_events: controller confirms programming and lock for Lunar eight six

name: Kruger and the Commissioner Discuss Board Pressure on the Escalator
description: Kruger and the Commissioner ride up an escalator. Kruger asks what the members of the board know about safety and says he should speak to them directly. The Commissioner replies that the board is under pressure from officials downtown and urges Kruger to recognize the political situation.
related_events: Kruger and Commissioner ascend escalator while discussing board pressure

name: Shuttle Landing Approach
description: The shuttle glides toward the glowing landing strip, its path illuminated in the dark. The captain turns to the co-pilot and says, 'It's out of our hands now, gentlemen.' The crew members exchange quiet smiles as the craft continues its descent.
related_events: Shuttle approaches lit landing strip
Captain declares control handed over
Crew members exchange smiles

name: Kruger and Commissioner Depart After Tense Exchange
description: Kruger and the Commissioner walk toward their limo. The Commissioner says, 'You handle your front office people, I'll handle the press and leave the boys in Washington to the boys downtown and the boys downtown to the boys on the board.' Kruger stops and looks at him. 'Commissioner,' he says. 'What?' the Commissioner replies. 'I just wish it was that simple,' Kruger says. A sharp musical sting underscores the moment. They get back into the limo and drive away.
related_events: Kruger and Commissioner discuss handling of political and press affairs
Kruger and Commissioner return to their limo and depart

name: Sarg Leaves Amid a Crowded Farewell
description: Sarg moves through the bedroom, stepping over half-clad athletes from various sports. Marge lies in bed, a cigar in her mouth, surrounded by football players. He leans down to kiss her goodbye. He tells her he won’t be back tonight—he’s testing retro-rockets. She says he doesn’t see something, something he never sees. He tells her they’ll talk tomorrow, promises it, then leaves.
related_events: Sarg climbs over athletes to kiss Marge goodbye
Sarg announces retro-rocket testing assignment
Marge confronts Sarg about his lack of understanding

name: Kruger and Commissioner Buy Cigarettes and Newspaper
description: Kruger takes a pack of cigarettes from a vending machine. The Commissioner buys a newspaper. Kruger says he will be the one blamed if something goes wrong.
related_events: Kruger obtains cigarettes from a vending machine
Commissioner purchases a newspaper
Kruger expresses concern about being held responsible for potential failure

name: Kruger and Commissioner Debate Shuttle Launch
description: Bud Kruger and the Commissioner step out of a limousine beneath a sign that reads 'MERCURY SHUTTLE.' As they walk toward the space center, Kruger states that the Mercury shuttle requires another month of pre-launch testing. The Commissioner dismisses the suggestion, saying the board expects the launch to proceed on schedule.
related_events: Kruger and Commissioner exit limousine at space center
Kruger expresses concern about Mercury shuttle readiness
Commissioner overrides Kruger's safety recommendation

name: Hack Through the Jungle to Reveal 'AIRPLANE II'
description: An American in a battered fedora and leather jacket hacks at thick jungle foliage with a machete, his two gunbearers following behind. From his back, the blade slices through vines and leaves, clearing a path. As the bushes part, a swarm of bats bursts out toward the camera. The clearing reveals massive stone letters, half-buried and overgrown, spelling out 'AIRPLANE II' amidst the ruins of an ancient structure.
related_events: American adventurer slashes through dense bush with machete
Bats emerge from disturbed foliage toward camera
Overgrown stone letters spelling 'AIRPLANE II' are revealed

name: Sarg Inspects the Wire and Sparks an Explosion
description: Sarg looks at the wire and shakes his head. He mutters about Ted Striker, recalling how Striker had warned about the same thing six months earlier during a test flight, only to be dismissed. Sarg spits a chunk of cigar onto the ground. The moment the cigar hits, a massive explosion erupts, hurling the worker out of frame.
related_events: Sarg shakes head after looking at the wire
Sarg criticizes Ted Striker's past warning
Sarg spits cigar on the ground
Massive explosion blows worker out of frame

name: Tour Kid Activates and Adjusts Video Game System
description: The CONTROLLER steps away from the video unit. A kid from the tour, lagging behind, reaches out and hits a switch. The screen flickers and shifts to a video game, accompanied by sound effects. The kid flips several knobs, adjusting the controls.
related_events: Screen transitions to video game with sound effects
Tour kid adjusts controls by flipping knobs

name: Controller Leaves Video Unit, Kid Activates Screen
description: The Controller steps away from the video unit. A child from the tour group, lagging behind, approaches the console and hits a switch. The screen changes to a video game, accompanied by sound effects. The child begins flipping the knobs on the device.
related_events: Controller moves away from video unit

name: Controller Announces Countdown Status, Workers Misunderstand and Return to Seats
description: A controller at Mercury launch control announces over the public address system that it is T-minus fifty-eight minutes and counting, confirming all systems are go and instructing personnel to clear the launch area. At a nearby table, NASA workers rise and begin collecting their dishes, apparently believing the launch activities have been put on hold. The controller's voice comes over the PA again, clarifying, 'I said launch, not lunch.' The workers pause, then sit back down at their table.
related_events: NASA workers begin leaving lunch table
Controller corrects workers via public address

name: Doctor Rumack Treats the Green-Conditioned Controller
description: After the launch announcement, Doctor Rumack, dressed in a physician's uniform, approaches the Controller and examines the inside of his mouth. Noticing the Controller's green complexion, Rumack hands him a set of pills followed by a glass of water. As the Controller takes the medication, Rumack explains that the water is made of two parts oxygen and one part hydrogen, helping the pills go down more easily.
related_events: Doctor Rumack examines Controller's mouth
Doctor Rumack administers pills and water to Controller

name: Controller Announces Launch Countdown
description: The Controller speaks over the P.A. system, declaring condition green and marking the launch at 'T' minus two hours. The message repeats clearly through the system.
related_events: Controller announces condition green and launch countdown

name: Shoe Shine with Political News
description: Kruger and the Commissioner sit for a shoe shine. A man nearby in white shoes reads a newspaper with the headline 'SOLAR PLANT MELTDOWN, 500 WORKERS SERIOUSLY TANNED' and does not notice as black polish is applied to his shoes. As the shoeshine proceeds, the Commissioner tells Kruger that officials downtown are under pressure from Washington, which is now affecting those on the board.
related_events: Kruger and Commissioner get their shoes shined
Commissioner explains pressure from Washington to Kruger

name: Man in White Shoes Receives Black Polish Unaware
description: At the shoe shine stand, a man wearing white shoes sits reading a newspaper. The shoeshine attendant applies black polish to his shoes, but the man does not react or look down, remaining focused on the paper. The headline he reads mentions a solar plant meltdown and hundreds of workers being seriously tanned. His shoes are now covered in black polish, though he appears unaware.
related_events: Man in white shoes fails to notice black polish on his shoes

name: Couple Reports Lost Travelers' Checks to Clerk
description: A young American couple approaches the desk clerk in distress, arguing about having lost all their travelers' checks. The man insists they were American Excess checks. The clerk, after hearing the type, throws up his hands and strikes a pose identical to the Karl Marden look-alike in the 'AMERICAN EXCESS' poster behind the desk, then tells them they're fucked. A young man nearby passes them and bounds up the stairs.
related_events: American couple argues with desk clerk about lost travelers' checks
Desk clerk reacts dismissively to lost American Excess travelers' checks

name: Young Man Leaves After Couple's Argument
description: A young man walks past a couple who are arguing with the desk clerk. Without stopping or speaking, he heads to the stairs and quickly climbs them, moving out of the area.
related_events: Young man bounds up the stairs after passing the couple

name: Sarg Confronts Kruger Over Faulty Shuttle Wiring
description: Sarg stands beside the burnt panel on the side of the shuttle, chewing on a cigar and holding a frayed wire. He speaks into a walkie-talkie, reporting that the damaged wiring could not have passed inspection without Simon Kurtz's approval. On the other end, Kruger, seated in his office, orders him to cover up the damage and get the shuttle ready for flight. Sarg agrees, but mutters that the situation reeks of a kickback. Kruger turns to a room filled with young boys in three-piece suits, each smoking a cigar. A large painting of three astronauts with wide eyes looms behind them. He asks the boys what they should do. In unison, they shout, 'Fuck him!'
related_events: Sarg inspects damaged shuttle wiring while reporting concerns
Sarg accuses board members of corruption in shuttle maintenance
Krugers issues order to conceal damage and prepare shuttle for flight

name: Kruger Commands Boys to Deliver Insult
description: After ending the phone call, Kruger turns to a room filled with young boys dressed in three-piece suits, each smoking a cigar. He addresses them, and on cue, all the boys respond in unison with a vulgar dismissal.
related_events: Krugers addresses group of boys in suits and prompts response
Group of boys in suits responds with coordinated insult

name: Sirens Wail as Controllers React to Explosion
description: A flash appears on the screen, followed by a loud explosion from outside. Sirens begin wailing. Controllers run in all directions, moving quickly through the area. The kid remains absorbed in play, then walks away without reacting.
related_events: Explosion occurs outside the building
Sirens begin wailing after the explosion
Controllers run around in response to the emergency

name: The Game and the Explosion
description: A flash erupts on the screen accompanied by the sound of a video game explosion. At the same moment, an explosion occurs outside, followed by the wail of sirens. Controllers scramble in response. The child, still holding the controller, continues playing without looking up. After a moment, the child simply walks away from the screen, unaffected by the commotion around them.
related_events: Video game explosion effect appears on screen
Child remains unaware of surroundings and walks away

name: Simon receives anti-fear pills and asks about fear
description: The druggist hands Simon a large bottle of pills labeled 'ANTI-FEAR PILLS.' Simon looks at the label and asks what the word 'fear' means. The druggist reads the label and replies that fear means to be afraid or over-anxious. Simon listens, then swallows a handful of the pills.
related_events: Druggist gives Simon a bottle of anti-fear pills
Simon reads the label on the pill bottle
Druggist defines the word 'fear'

name: Simon Takes the Pills and Walks Through a Window
description: After reading the label and learning the meaning of 'fear,' Simon swallows a handful of the anti-fear pills. He then walks directly through a plate glass window, emerging unharmed on the other side.
related_events: Simon swallows a handful of anti-fear pills
Simon walks through a plate glass window unharmed

name: Miners Head to Terminal After P.A. Call
description: A public address announcement echoes through the terminal, calling all Pulsar Four mining personnel to report to the Resource Expeditions office on level seven. Two miners stop unloading futuristic gear from a TRX Deep Space Resource Management truck and make their way toward the terminal doors. As they approach, they pass four nuns who are bidding farewell to Father O'Flanagan. He shakes hands with the first three, then pulls the young, striking nun into a passionate kiss. An older nun reprimands him, saying, 'No tongues, Father.' The miners continue through the doors without pause.
related_events: Miners unload equipment from TRX Deep Space truck at LAX terminal
P.A. system announces call for Pulsar Four mining personnel
Two miners head to terminal doors after P.A. announcement

name: Father O'Flanagan Kisses Young Nun and Is Reprimanded by Elder Nun
description: Father O'Flanagan stands with four nuns during a farewell. He shakes hands with the first three, then takes the young nun in his arms and kisses her passionately. As he does, the older nun nearby speaks up, saying, 'No tongues, Father.'
related_events: Father O'Flanagan kisses young nun passionately during farewell
Older nun reprimands Father O'Flanagan for using tongue in kiss

name: Oveur and Simon Hurry While Simon Explains Dry Cleaning and Amphibian Digestion
description: Oveur and Simon walk quickly along a pathway. As they move, Simon explains how dry cleaning works. He then begins to talk about the digestive system of amphibians. Oveur interrupts, asking if it's really necessary to go over all these details. Simon spots Ted speaking with a security guard ahead. He tells Oveur he’ll meet him on board, then breaks away to attend to something.
related_events: Oveur and Simon hurry along a pathway
Simon explains dry cleaning process to Oveur
Simon attempts to discuss amphibian digestion with Oveur
Oveur questions necessity of Simon's explanations

name: Simon Sees Ted and Leaves Oveur
description: Oveur and Simon hurry along. Simon spots Ted getting directions from a security guard. He tells Oveur he needs to take care of something first and will meet him on board. Simon then heads off, leaving Oveur alone.
related_events: Simon notices Ted receiving directions from security guard
Simon decides to delay boarding to attend to personal matter

name: Ted Striker Deals with Bird on Plane and Pulls Control Stick
description: Ted Striker flies the aircraft at high speed through clouds, the oxygen mask hanging loose from his helmet. A bird lands on the nose of the plane, just in front of the cockpit window. Ted knocks on the glass, scaring the bird away. He takes a drink of beer and pulls back sharply on the control stick, tilting the plane upward.
related_events: Bird lands on aircraft nose in front of cockpit window
Ted Striker shoos bird away by knocking on cockpit glass
Ted Striker cockily pulls aircraft control stick

name: Ted Striker Drinks Beer While Flying at High Speed
description: Ted Striker is at the controls of the aircraft, flying through clouds at approximately 700 miles per hour. His oxygen mask hangs loose from his helmet. A bird lands on the nose of the plane in front of the windshield. Ted knocks on the glass to scare it away. He takes a swig of beer and pulls on the control stick.
related_events: Ted Striker drinks beer while piloting aircraft

name: Ted Striker Flies at High Speed Through Clouds
description: Ted Striker is at the controls of an aircraft moving at least 700 MPH. Clouds streak past outside the cockpit. An oxygen mask hangs loose from his helmet. A bird lands on the nose of the plane in front of the window. Ted knocks on the glass, and the bird flies away. He takes a drink of beer and pulls on the control stick.
related_events: Ted Striker takes control of aircraft at high speed through clouds

name: Ted's Rise and Fall with the XR-2300
description: Ted paces, speaking to himself about being named chief test pilot for NASA's XR-2300, the first Mercury shuttle. He recalls how he reported serious flaws in the spacecraft, only to be reassigned to testing outdated F-18s for a general who suspects communists in the Amazon. As he talks, the scene shifts, revealing an empty cross and a man hanging beside him, feet dangling in the air. Suddenly, a boy bursts in, calling out to him. Ted spins around, startled, but the paper in front of him remains still. He freezes, staring. 'My God,' he says. 'They're launching the ZR-2300.' The boy asks what it is. Ted replies it's not the ZR, but the XR-2300—the Mercury shuttle—and they can't do it.
related_events: Ted reflects on becoming chief test pilot for the XR-2300
Ted reports critical flaws in the XR-2300
Ted begins testing old F-18s for a paranoid Generalissimo

name: Ted Reacts to the ZR-2300 Launch
description: The boy bursts into the room, calling out to Ted. Ted spins around, startled, and sees the launch in progress. His eyes lock onto the ascending spacecraft. 'My God! They're launching the ZR-2300,' he says. The boy offers a guess: 'The muffler bracket for a '78 Pinto?' Ted quickly corrects him. 'No, that's an XR-2200. The XR-2300 is the Mercury shuttle. They can't do it!'
related_events: Boy bursts into the room and alerts Ted
Ted realizes the ZR-2300 is being launched
Ted corrects the boy about the XR-2300's identity

name: Ted Follows Elaine and Insists on Being Heard
description: Ted follows Elaine through the crowded space, speaking urgently as he tries to keep her attention. He insists that someone has to listen to him and declares he is going straight to mission control. Elaine stops briefly, looking at him with concern, and tells him he should go back to the hospital. Without waiting for a response, she walks away. As she leaves, a young man passes by carrying a large oak cabinet, a television and stereo console balanced on his shoulder, the sound of disco music filling the air. Ted stands still, then turns away, lost in thought.
related_events: Ted follows Elaine through the environment
Elaine urges Ted to return to the hospital

name: Ted's Flashback After Elaine Leaves
description: After Elaine walks away and tells Ted to return to the hospital, Ted stands alone. A moment later, his expression shifts, and the scene dissolves into a flashback.
related_events: Ted experiences a flashback after Elaine leaves

name: Ted and Elaine as a passerby carries an oak console
description: Ted calls out to Elaine, insisting that someone has to listen to him and that he is going to mission control. Elaine responds by telling him he should go back to the hospital, then walks away. As they speak, a young person walks through the scene carrying a large oak cabinet, five feet wide, three feet high, and two feet deep, with a television and stereo console balanced on their shoulder. Disco music plays in the background.
related_events: A passerby carries a large oak entertainment console through the scene

name: Workers Maintain Ship's Exterior Systems
description: Workers on scaffolding move along the side of the massive spaceship, checking gauges and inspecting equipment. One worker pulls open a panel marked 'SOLID FUEL CHUTE.' Flames burst out as another worker, shirt soaked with sweat, shovels coal into the opening. Sparks fly and heat ripples through the air. Nearby, others continue their rounds, monitoring readings and adjusting controls. Suddenly, a panel farther down the hull explodes, sending smoke and sparking wires into the air. A worker rushes forward, pulling out a walkie-talkie and shouting into it.
related_events: Pan across workers checking gauges on ship exterior
Worker opens solid fuel chute panel causing flames to shoot out
Worker shovels coal into solid fuel chute

name: Worker Calls for Sarg After Panel Explosion at Mercury Station Six
description: A control panel at Mercury station six suddenly explodes, sending smoke and sparks into the air. Wires dangle and flicker as a worker rushes to the scene. He pulls out a walkie-talkie and calls urgently, 'This is Mercury station six! Get me the Sarg and fast!'
related_events: Panel explodes at Mercury station six
Worker calls for the Sarg using walkie-talkie

name: Camera Falls During Spaceship Shot
description: The camera tilts upward, capturing the underbelly of a massive spaceship as the music swells. The shot continues as if someone is looking up from the ground, following the curve of the ship's hull. Suddenly, the camera lurches, tumbles, and crashes to the ground. The music cuts off abruptly with a jarring silence.
related_events: Camera crashes to the ground during space theme shot

name: Simon and Captain Oveur Leave Together
description: Simon approaches Captain Oveur at the airport. Captain Oveur responds with 'Mr. Kurtz, I presume.' Simon says they don't have much time and urges immediate departure, offering to explain later. The two walk away together past the Transcendental Air counter. As they pass, two Hari Krishna agents smile at customers and ask, 'Chanting or non-chanting?'
related_events: Simon approaches and identifies Captain Oveur
Captain Oveur acknowledges Simon as Mr. Kurtz
Simon urges immediate departure and offers explanation later
Captain Oveur and Simon walk away past the Transcendental Air counter
related_occasions: Hari Krishna Outreach Activity At The Airport

name: Captain Oveur Buys Flight Insurance
description: Captain Oveur approaches an automated machine and completes a transaction to purchase flight insurance. After the purchase, he turns away from the machine just as Simon arrives and addresses him. They begin to walk together past the Transcendental Air counter, where two Hari Krishna agents stand smiling at passing customers, one of them asking, 'Chanting or non-chanting?'
related_events: Captain Oveur purchases flight insurance from a machine

name: Hari Krishna Agents Offer Chanting to Travelers
description: Two Hari Krishna agents stand near the Transcendental Air counter, smiling at passing travelers. They approach customers and offer a choice between chanting and non-chanting participation.
related_events: Two Hari Krishna agents interact with customers at the airport
related_occasions: Hari Krishna Outreach Activity At The Airport

name: Kruger Reports a Murder and Clashes with the Commissioner
description: Kruger tells the Commissioner that someone has been senselessly murdered just minutes ago. The Commissioner responds that it doesn't make sense. Kruger wonders how officials in Washington will react to the news. The Commissioner cuts him off, insisting that matters involving Washington belong to those handling local affairs and refuses to entertain further discussion on federal involvement. Kruger shifts focus, stating that only one other pilot, Clarence Oveur, can handle the shuttle, and orders Jacobs to pull him from duty. Jacobs misunderstands and offers a cardigan instead, then runs out. The Commissioner throws an album onto Kruger's desk. It shows a photo of Oveur holding an accordion, with the title 'CLARENCE OVEUR'S 400 POLKA FAVORITES.' A dramatic accordion sting plays.
related_events: Kruger reports a recent senseless murder to the Commissioner
Kruger questions how Washington will respond to the murder
Commissioner asserts jurisdictional boundaries with Kruger

name: Kruger Orders Oveur Pulled, Jacobs Misunderstands and Flees
description: Kruger states that Clarence Oveur is the only other pilot capable of handling the shuttle and announces that Oveur must be pulled from his lunar flight. He turns to Jacobs and gives the order to pull Oveur. Jacobs responds by saying he doesn’t have anything in Kruger’s size but offers a cardigan, then runs out of the room. The Commissioner throws an album onto Kruger’s desk, revealing a photo of Oveur with an accordion, titled 'CLARENCE OVEUR'S 400 POLKA FAVORITES,' as a dramatic accordion sting plays.
related_events: Kruger orders Jacobs to pull pilot Clarence Oveur from his lunar flight
Jacobs misunderstands Kruger's order as a clothing request and flees

name: The Commissioner Throws Oveur's Polka Album
description: The Commissioner picked up an album and hurled it onto Kruger's desk. It landed with a sharp thud, the cover showing Clarence Oveur holding an accordion, beneath the bold title 'CLARENCE OVEUR'S 400 POLKA FAVORITES'. At that moment, a dramatic accordian sting rang out.
related_events: Commissioner places Clarence Oveur's polka album on Kruger's desk

name: Sarg and Marge Exchange Crisis Calls
description: Sarg, dressed in a tuxedo with his tie loose and a cigar in hand, speaks into his car phone while a worker in a hard hat stands nearby. Behind the worker, fuel drums line the area beneath a large sign that reads: DANGER, FUEL -- ABSOLUTELY NO SMOKING, ABSOLUTELY NO SPITTING. Sarg tells his wife Marge that he cannot join her, saying, "Marge, you better go without me. We've got a condition red." The scene splits to show Marge at home, wearing an evening gown and with a cigar in her mouth. She replies that their marriage is in crisis, saying, "We've got a condition red with our marriage. I think you're in love with that shuttle, not with me. I want a divorce, Sarg." Sarg asks if there is someone else. Marge responds that there has been someone else for fifteen years and that he was too focused on work to notice. They hang up without further words.
related_events: Sarg communicates urgent work situation to his wife over car phone
Marge declares marital crisis and requests divorce

name: Sarg's Explosive Reaction
description: Sarg stands beside a worker in a hard hat near fuel drums, a large sign behind them reading DANGER, FUEL -- ABSOLUTELY NO SMOKING, ABSOLUTELY NO SPITTING. On the car phone, his wife Marge, wearing an evening gown and with a cigar in her mouth, tells him she wants a divorce, revealing there has been someone else for fifteen years. After they hang up, Sarg lights his cigar, throws the match toward the 'NO SMOKING' sign, then bites off the end of the cigar and spits it in the direction of the 'NO SPITTING' sign. A massive explosion erupts from the fuel storage area, blowing the worker out of frame. Sarg climbs into his car, takes a lava lamp from the seat, places it on the roof, and drives away as the lamp flashes and the siren wails.
related_events: Sarg lights cigar near prohibited area despite warning sign
Marge reveals long-term infidelity and ends marriage over phone call
Sarg bites cigar and triggers massive explosion near fuel storage area

name: Sarg's Emergency Departure
description: After the explosion, Sarg opens the car door, picks up a lava lamp from the passenger seat, and sets it on the roof of the vehicle. The lamp begins to flash, and a siren sounds. Sarg starts the engine and drives away quickly.
related_events: Sarg places lava lamp on car roof and activates makeshift siren

name: Ted Causes Chaotic Taxi Pile-Up
description: Ted rushes out and hails a taxi. A dozen cars screech, swerve, and crash into one another, piling up in a tangled wreck. Horns blare continuously as the vehicles come to rest in a mangled heap. Ted jumps into the taxi at the bottom of the pile. The driver pounds on the horn, which remains stuck, blaring loudly as the taxi pulls away, dragging other taxis with it. Ted throws a map onto the front seat floor, and the driver steps on it while driving.
related_events: Ted rushes out and hails a taxi
Multiple cars screech and crash in chaotic pile-up

name: Escape in a Tangled Taxi
description: Ted climbs into the taxi at the bottom of the pile of wrecked cars. The driver slams his hand on the horn repeatedly, and the horn blares continuously. The taxi lurches forward, pulling away from the crash site while dragging other damaged taxis behind it.
related_events: Ted climbs into taxi at bottom of crash pile
Taxi driver repeatedly pounds on horn
Taxi pulls away dragging other taxis

name: Ted Directs the Taxi Driver Through Houston
description: Ted rushes out and hails a taxi, jumping into the one at the bottom of a tangled pile of crashed cars. As the driver pounds on the horn, which blares continuously, Ted throws a map onto the floor of the front seat. The driver steps on the map while accelerating. Ted shouts urgent directions: 'Right at the corner, left at the light,' as the taxi pulls away, dragging other taxis behind it.
related_events: Ted throws map onto taxi floor
Ted gives urgent directions to Houston destination
Driver steps on map while driving

name: Wilson Family Heads to Mercury Shuttle Processing
description: The Wilson family—John, Alice, and their ten-year-old son Jimmy—gather their luggage and make their way toward passenger processing for the Mercury shuttle. Jimmy carries a small cage containing his puppy, Scraps. Over the loudspeaker, a public announcement directs all Mercury passengers to proceed to concourse level 'C.' John confirms it's their shuttle, and they begin moving toward the designated area. A porter approaches to assist, taking one of their bags. He notices the puppy and tells Jimmy that dogs aren't allowed on the shuttle. When Jimmy protests, the porter pulls out a handgun and shoots, startling everyone. Jimmy cries out for Scraps, but the porter laughs, revealing the gun was loaded with blanks. The adults laugh, while Jimmy remains upset. Nearby, a man lifts a large dog cage from a taxi, inside which is another man wearing S&M leathers. The man carrying the cage tells the one inside that if he doesn't fit under the seat, he'll be stored with the luggage. The man in the cage appears to enjoy the idea. Two porters place the cage on a conveyor belt beside Jimmy's dog.
related_events: Wilson family proceeds to passenger processing for Mercury shuttle

name: Porter Approaches the Wilson Family and Notices Scraps
description: The Wilson family is carrying their luggage when a porter approaches to help. He takes a bag from John and notices the small cage Jimmy is holding. Inside is a puppy named Scraps. The porter asks Jimmy if it's his dog. Jimmy confirms and asks if Scraps can sit with them on the shuttle. The porter shakes his head and says no dogs are allowed on the shuttle.
related_events: Porter offers assistance and notices Scraps in the cage
Jimmy expresses concern about Scraps sitting with the family on the shuttle

name: Porter Frightens Jimmy with Fake Shooting of Scraps
description: The Porter notices the puppy in the cage and tells Jimmy that no dogs are allowed on the shuttle. He then pulls out a handgun and shoots, claiming the dog must be put down. Jimmy screams in horror as the gun fires a blank. The Porter laughs, showing that the gun wasn't real and that Scraps is unharmed. Alice and John join in laughing, but when Jimmy continues to cry, they exchange glances, looking at him as if something is wrong.
related_events: Porter jokes about shooting Scraps with a blank gunshot
Jimmy reacts with distress to the fake shooting of Scraps
Alice and John react with amusement while questioning Jimmy's emotional response

name: Man Places Caged Individual on Conveyor Belt
description: A man lifts a large dog cage out of a taxi's trunk, revealing another man inside wearing S&M leathers. The man holding the cage tells the one inside that if he doesn't fit under a seat, he'll be locked up with the luggage. The caged man appears to take pleasure in the suggestion. Two porters then lift the cage and place it on a conveyor belt, setting it down next to a smaller cage containing a puppy.
related_events: Man with cage retrieves caged man from taxi trunk
Man with cage threatens to store caged man with luggage
Two Porters place cage on conveyor belt beside Jimmy's dog

name: Family Arrives at Terminal with Belongings
description: An old truck loaded with furniture pulls up to the terminal. A young man and his parents step out. The son looks around and says they have finally made it to Mercury, ready to start over. He bends down, takes a handful of earth from the sidewalk, and lets it sift through his fingers. He speaks of rich soil, strong unions, and a place where black and white men can work together and move mountains.
related_events: Family arrives at terminal in old truck loaded with furniture
Son expresses hope for new life in Mercury
Son handles soil from terminal sidewalk
Son envisions racial unity in labor

name: Porter's Attempt to Help Causes Belongings to Collapse
description: A black porter approaches the family’s pile of belongings and reaches for a bag at the bottom of the stack. As he pulls it, the entire heap of junk shifts and tumbles to the ground, scattering their possessions across the pavement.
related_events: Porter approaches and takes bag from family's pile
Porter pulls bag causing junk to cascade to the ground

name: Ted Arrives in Damaged Taxi and Pays Three Dollars
description: A taxi covered in mud and trailing flames from under the hood pulls up to the terminal, horn blaring. The driver flips off the meter, which displays an impossibly large number. He turns to Ted and demands eight hundred and seventy-four zillion quastavitas. Ted reaches into his pocket, pulls out three dollars, hands it to the driver, and tells him to keep the change.
related_events: Ted's taxi arrives covered in mud with flames under the hood
Driver flips off taxi meter showing extremely high fare
Driver demands payment of eight hundred and seventy-four zillion quastavitas
Ted offers three dollars and tells driver to keep the change

name: Simon's Stop at the Drugstore
description: Simon tells Elaine to meet him onboard and steps into a drugstore to pick up a few things. As he passes the clerk, the man whispers an offer of uppers, downers, coke, speed, hash, and Tampax. Inside, a woman wearing a black garter belt exits a photo booth followed by a donkey. Elsewhere, Ted approaches Elaine, who checks her watch and tells him not to make things harder. Ted asks what happened between them, and Elaine replies that she loved him and always will, but she needs Simon now. She says Simon is stable, a good provider, and doesn't know the meaning of fear—qualities she wants at this point in her life.
related_events: Simon asks Elaine to meet him onboard
Simon enters the drugstore past the drugstore clerk
Drugstore clerk offers illegal substances to Simon
related_occasions: Photo Booth Session At The Drugstore

name: Elaine Rejects Ted at the Drugstore
description: Elaine waits outside the drugstore, glancing at her watch as Simon goes inside. A drugstore clerk murmurs a list of items to Simon as he passes. Nearby, a photo booth flashes. Ted approaches Elaine. She tells him not to make things harder. He asks what happened between them. She replies that she loved him and always will, but she needs Simon now. She says Simon is stable, a good provider, and doesn't know the meaning of fear. A woman wearing a black garter belt steps out of the photo booth, followed by a donkey.
related_events: Elaine checks her watch and urges Simon to return quickly
Ted approaches Elaine near the photo booth
Elaine tells Ted to stop making things difficult
Elaine confesses her emotional commitment to Simon while rejecting Ted
related_occasions: Photo Booth Session At The Drugstore

name: Woman and Donkey Exit Photo Booth
description: A woman wearing a black garter belt steps out of a photo booth, followed by a donkey. The two pass through the drugstore as Elaine and Ted stand nearby, engaged in conversation. The flash of the photo booth lights up the area in quick bursts.
related_events: Woman in black garter belt exits photo booth accompanied by a donkey
related_occasions: Photo Booth Session At The Drugstore

name: Frank Morgan Meets Jane Dennis Outside Bookstore
description: Frank Morgan kisses Jane Dennis outside a bookstore window displaying yellow-covered books with plain black titles like 'DEEP BOOK,' 'FASCINATING BOOK,' and 'THE WORLD ACCORDING TO JOHN DOE,' advertised as 'NO-NAME BOOKS.' The two speak quietly, and Frank tells Jane that his wife Carol won’t grant him a divorce easily. Jane expresses concern that Carol might react violently, but Frank dismisses her fears, insisting Carol is not violent.
related_events: Frank Morgan kisses Jane Dennis outside a bookstore
Frank Morgan discusses divorce difficulties with Jane Dennis
Jane Dennis expresses fear of Carol's violent behavior
Frank Morgan dismisses Jane's concerns about Carol's violence

name: Carol Shoots and Flees After Confrontation
description: Frank sees his wife Carol and calls out her name. Carol responds by pulling out a gun. Frank pleads, 'No! This is senseless!' before she fires the weapon. The gunshot causes Jane Dennis and several other women nearby to faint. Two S.W.A.T. cops also collapse dramatically. Carol turns and runs from the scene immediately after shooting, leaving chaos behind.
related_events: Carol pulls out a gun in response to Frank Morgan calling her name
Frank Morgan pleads with Carol to stop before she shoots
Carol shoots a firearm causing multiple people to faint
Carol flees the scene immediately after shooting

name: Headline Updates After Shooting
description: After Carol fires the gun and flees the scene, the electronic newspaper display nearby changes its headline. The percentage in the flashing text jumps from 'SENSELESS MURDER UP 99%' to '120% AND RISING!' The updated headline glows prominently in the background as chaos unfolds.
related_events: Newspaper headline updates electronically showing success rate jump to 120%

name: Ted Remembers the Loss at Macho Grande
description: A closeup of a parachute fills the screen, followed by a pan across a disheveled room—clothes scattered, a flight jacket draped over a chair, a framed photo of Ted and Elaine on the bedside table next to a bottle of whiskey. The air is thick with heat and dust. Ted lies on the bed, drenched in sweat, a cigarette dangling from his lip and a drink in his hand. He takes a sip, swallows the cigarette without notice. Above the bed, a crucifix bears a real person nailed to it. Dogfight footage flickers in the air, planes roaring through the sky. A voice shouts, 'You're too low, Striker! You're too low!' The figure on the crucifix turns his head, searching for the source of the noise. Ted speaks quietly to himself, 'Who could have figured it would come to this. It'll be twenty years this week that I lost my entire squadron over Macho Grande. Planes, too.'
related_events: Ted recalls losing squadron over Macho Grande
Crucifix appears to react to dogfight footage

name: Ted Avoids Pigeons in Park After War
description: After the war, Ted walks through a park, flinching at the sight of pigeons. He steps quickly to avoid them, changing direction when birds take flight nearby. One pigeon lands on a crucifix in his hotel room, where the air is hot and still. Ted lies on the bed, sweating, a cigarette in his mouth and a drink in his hand.
related_events: Ted avoids pigeons in park after war
Pigeon lands on crucifix in hotel room

name: Ted Pilots Plane to Chicago Alone
description: Ted finds himself at the controls of a 167 aircraft, flying into Chicago without a crew. The plane carries no other personnel, and he navigates the flight alone. Dust and heat fill the room where he now lies, sweat soaking his body as he recalls the moment. A flight jacket rests over a chair, clothes are scattered, and a bottle of whiskey sits beside a framed photo of Ted and Elaine. He takes a drink, accidentally swallowing a cigarette still dangling from his lips. Above the bed, a crucifix hangs with a real person on it. The sound of planes echoes as a pigeon lands nearby, wings flapping. The fan beside him roars to life, tearing through the room with violent force as he struggles to turn it off.
related_events: Ted ends up piloting plane to Chicago without crew

name: Ted Recalls His Rise to Fame Through Headlines
description: Ted lies on a sweat-soaked bed in a hot, dusty room, a cigarette dangling from his lip as he takes a drink and accidentally swallows the cigarette without reaction. A crucifix hangs above the bed, a real person nailed to it. A series of images appear: a newspaper headline from the New York Times reads 'STRIKER SAVES 120!' beneath a photo of Ted and Elaine waving. Another headline from the Houston Tribune announces 'FLYING HEROES ACCEPT NASA POSTS,' showing the same couple waving again. A tabloid cover displays the story 'TED IMPOTENT? ELAINE FRIGID?' with a smaller headline beside it reading 'JFK ALIVE, SAYS UROLOGIST!' Ted wipes his face and turns on a table fan, which erupts into a tornado-like force, tearing the room apart as he struggles to shut it off.
related_events: Ted reflects on past fame while news headlines display his and Elaine's public recognition

name: Ted Endures Chaos in a Sweltering Hotel Room
description: Ted lies on a bed in a hot, dusty hotel room, soaked in sweat, a cigarette dangling from his lip and a drink in his hand. He takes a sip of whiskey, forgets to remove the cigarette, and swallows it without reaction. Later, he reaches over and switches on a table fan. The fan erupts with a violent gust, unleashing a tornado-like wind that tears through the room, scattering clothes, knocking over the chair, and upending the bottle of whiskey as Ted struggles to turn it off.
related_events: Ted swallows cigarette while drinking on hotel bed
Ted struggles with malfunctioning table fan causing destructive wind in hotel room

name: Boy Takes Newspaper and Flees Through Town Square
description: A peasant boy takes a newspaper from a newsstand. The headline reads, 'MERCURY SHUTTLE FLIES TOMORROW.' He runs through the town square, passing a large alabaster statue of the Generalissimo snorting cocaine. Soldiers drag nuns away while other nuns drag soldiers away, all screaming. He passes a line of peasants held at gunpoint. A soldier asks the first peasant, 'Traficante de drugas o communista?' The peasant replies, 'Traficante de drugas, traficante de drugas!' The soldier lets him go. The soldier asks the second peasant the same question. The peasant panics and runs. The soldiers open fire. The boy continues running toward the Hotel Montenegro. A sign on the hotel reads, 'TV, POOL, WATERBEDS, DONKEY, KLEENEX,' with all words except 'KLEENEX' crossed out. He runs inside.
related_events: Peasant boy takes newspaper from newsstand
Peasant boy runs through town square

name: Soldiers Interrogate Peasants in Town Square
description: Soldiers hold a line of peasants at gunpoint in the town square. One by one, they question the peasants, demanding, 'Drug dealer or communist?' The first peasant answers, 'Drug dealer, drug dealer!' and the soldier releases him. The second peasant, when asked the same question, panics and tries to run. The soldiers open fire. The soldier shouts, 'Communist!'
related_events: Soldiers hold peasants at gunpoint in a line
Soldier interrogates first peasant about drug dealing or communism
Soldier releases first peasant after interrogation

name: Second Peasant Flees and Is Shot
description: The soldier asks the second peasant, 'Drug dealer or communist?' The peasant panics and runs. The soldiers open fire. As the peasant lies dead, the soldier says, 'Communist.'
related_events: Soldier interrogates second peasant about drug dealing or communism
Second peasant panics and flees from soldiers
Soldiers open fire on fleeing peasant
Soldier declares fleeing peasant a communist

name: Peasant Flees to Hotel Montenegro as Soldier Pursues
description: The peasant bolts from the line and sprints across the town square. Soldiers open fire. He stumbles forward, reaching the Hotel Montenegro, and rushes inside. A soldier gives chase, following him through the entrance.
related_events: Second peasant panics and flees from soldiers
Soldier chases peasant to Hotel Montenegro
Peasant enters Hotel Montenegro to escape soldiers

name: Nuns and Soldiers Drag Each Other Away
description: In the town square, soldiers drag nuns away as they scream. Elsewhere, nuns drag soldiers away while the soldiers scream.
related_events: Soldiers drag nuns away while they scream
Nuns drag soldiers away while they scream

name: Ted and Mrs. Gooch at the Orgasmic Experiences Booth
description: Ted pushes through a crowd near a spherical booth labeled 'ORGASMIC EXPERIENCES, 25.' An elderly woman, Mrs. Gooch, stops him and asks if he has change for a twenty in quarters. Ted reaches for his wallet and offers two ten-dollar bills, but she thanks him and declines. He moves on, passing a police line that has been set up around a body marked with chalk.
related_events: Ted pushes through crowd near Orgasmic Experiences booth
Mrs. Gooch asks Ted for change in quarters
Ted attempts to retrieve two ten-dollar bills from wallet
Ted continues past police line at murder scene

name: Detective Hallick at the Chalk Outline
description: Detective Hallick kneels beside Frank Morgan's body, which is surrounded by a chalk mark. He notes that this is the twelfth victim this week with the same marking. He orders the entire terminal to be cordoned off, everyone inside to be booked and questioned, and demands that all who have seen The Sound of Music be investigated. He barks an order to evacuate the entire population of Hawaii into the water within an hour. When accordions begin playing 'Lady of Spain' around him, he snaps at the sergeant to cordon off the area, not 'accordion off.' He then commands the scene to be dusted for fingerprints. A police officer uses a duster on the wall, and others follow, hanging prints of paintings by Picasso and Lautrec. Another officer checks people's upper dental plates. A police photographer straddles the body and takes pictures in a 'Blow-Up' style, shouting 'Super! Great! Super! Terrific! Super!'
related_events: Detective Hallick examines Frank Morgan's body with chalk outline
Detective Hallick identifies pattern in twelve recent chalk-marked homicides
Detective Hallick orders terminal lockdown and mass interrogation
Detective Hallick demands evacuation of Hawaii's population
Detective Hallick orders crime scene to be dusted for fingerprints
Cops hang famous artwork prints at crime scene

name: Detective Hallick Questions the Camera After Bizarre Orders
description: Detective Hallick stands over the body marked with chalk, surrounded by accordion players performing 'Lady of Spain.' He barks orders to cordon off the area, dust for prints, and check people's dental plates. A police photographer straddles the corpse, snapping pictures in a 'Blow-Up' style while shouting 'Super! Great! Super! Terrific! Super!' Hallick turns to the camera and says, 'When will this senseless killing end?'
related_events: Detective Hallick questions end of senseless killings directly to camera

name: Police Photographer Captures Body in Stylized Shots
description: A police photographer straddles Frank Morgan's body and takes a series of dramatic, stylized photographs in the manner of the film 'Blow-Up.' As he works, he calls out with enthusiasm, shouting 'Super! Great! Super! Terrific! Super!' while framing the body from various angles.
related_events: Police Photographer takes stylized photos of body in 'Blow-Up' fashion

name: Sergeant Asks When the Killings Will End
description: At the murder scene, the sergeant looks down at Detective Hallick beside Frank Morgan's body, which is outlined in chalk. 'When is this senseless killing going to stop?' the sergeant asks. Detective Hallick rises to his feet, scanning the area as accordions begin to play 'Lady of Spain.'
related_events: Sergeant questions end of senseless killings at crime scene

name: Simon and Elaine Arrive at the Airport Amid Chaos
description: Simon Kurtz and Elaine Thompson step out of a taxi wearing matching flight outfits, each carrying hand luggage. As they begin to walk, a Japanese man steps out of another taxi weighed down by dozens of cameras hanging around his neck. His wife adds another camera to the collection, and he immediately collapses under the load. Simon and Elaine glance at the scene as they continue toward the terminal entrance.
related_events: Simon Kurtz and Elaine Thompson exit taxi in flight outfits with hand luggage
Japanese man collapses under weight of cameras

name: Simon and Elaine Buy a Rose from a Chrysler Bailout Salesman
description: Simon Kurtz and Elaine Thompson step out of a taxi with hand luggage, dressed in matching flight outfits. As they walk, a businessman approaches them holding a bouquet of roses. He asks if they would like to buy a rose to help bail out Chrysler, explaining that they are an all-profit organization. Simon hands the man a dollar and takes a rose. The businessman joins six others holding signs with Lee Iacocca's picture. Together, they smile and begin chanting: 'IACCOCA, IACCOCA, IACCOCA, IARAMA.' Simon gives the rose to Elaine, who takes his arm as they continue walking toward the 'MERCURY SHUTTLE' sign.
related_events: Businessman offers rose to Simon and Elaine to support Chrysler bailout
Simon buys a rose from the businessman
Businessmen chant Iacocca slogan in coordinated display

name: Simon and Elaine Share a Romantic Moment Before the Shuttle
description: Simon hands the rose he bought to Elaine, and she takes his arm as they walk together toward the sign that reads 'MERCURY SHUTTLE.' Simon tells her she is the best little computer officer on the Mercury mission and remarks that it's hard to believe she once worked as a stewardess on the Denver-Chicago run. Elaine smiles and says she feels lucky to be engaged to him.
related_events: Simon gives rose to Elaine and they walk together toward Mercury Shuttle sign
Simon compliments Elaine on her role in the Mercury mission
Simon reflects on Elaine's past as a stewardess
Elaine expresses disbelief and gratitude about engagement to Simon

name: Simon and Elaine Discuss Future After Marriage
description: Simon and Elaine walk toward the Mercury Shuttle terminal, hand in hand. Simon remarks on how far women have come in the space program, then says that after they are married, Elaine will no longer work with complicated computers. Elaine responds that she has been offered the position of head of the computer analysis division for the Jupiter probe. Simon ignores the offer and tells her she will instead be in charge of raising children as Mrs. Simon Kurtz, calling it a direct order. He kisses her, and she does not respond. Around them, a man walks a suitcase on a leash that suddenly lunges at a post and urinates. Another person with a leashed suitcase passes by, and the two cases begin snapping and growling at each other like fighting dogs.
related_events: Simon comments on women's role in space program and assigns Elaine domestic role
Elaine reveals offer to lead computer analysis division for Jupiter probe
Simon declares Elaine's new role as mother and gives it as an order
Simon kisses Elaine after declaring her domestic role

name: Man Pulled by Leashed Suitcase in Bizarre Airport Encounter
description: A man walks through the area, being pulled along by a suitcase on a leash that drags him forward as if it were a dog. The suitcase stops at a post and urinates on it. As the man continues, he passes a woman who also has a suitcase on a leash. The two suitcases immediately lunge at each other, snarling and barking like aggressive dogs, and begin a violent fight.
related_events: Man with suitcase on leash is pulled along by the suitcase
Suitcase takes a leak on a post
Two people with leashed suitcases pass each other
Suitcases engage in violent dog fight with barking

name: Ted Accuses Simon of Conspiracy as Elaine Delivers Pills
description: Ted lies in a hospital bed with electrodes attached to his head, inside the Ronald Reagan Institute of Supply-Side Economics and Hospital for the Criminally Insane. A nurse in a uniform that reads 'I (heart) NORMAL' hands him pills, but stops him before he takes them. She tells him the dose costs $38. Ted pays her in bills. Elaine appears on the other side of the bed, turns off a radio, and opens a box of spaghetti-to-go. She urges Ted to eat, saying it will make him feel better. A groaning sound comes from off-screen. When Elaine asks who it is, Ted says it's Sammy Davis Junior, who hasn't been the same since a terrible car accident. A nurse is seen pulling a long oil dip-stick from the mouth of a gold-chain-wearing patient, wiping it, and putting it back. Ted tells Elaine that Simon Kurtz had him put in the hospital to get him out of the way. Elaine replies that his mental hygiene is what matters most now. A man in rags, chained to the wall, chants, 'It works... No, it doesn't... Yes, it does.' Ted tells Elaine his name is David Stockman and that he's been there twenty years, repeating the same words. Elaine reminds Ted that the first step to sanity is admitting he's sick, and encourages him to accept his electro-shock treatment so he can return to the space center. She then tells him she is leaving him for Simon. Ted gags on his spaghetti. Elaine says she can't live with someone who won't deal with reality and that it's best for everyone. She leans in to kiss him, but he turns away. He tells her not to say goodbye, just to go. She flips a switch by the bed, thinking it's the radio, but it activates the electro-shock machine. Ted's body convulses as she walks out.
related_events: Ted accuses Simon Kurtz of conspiring to institutionalize him
Elaine emphasizes Ted's mental hygiene over conspiracy claims
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Elaine Brings Spaghetti and Says Goodbye
description: Elaine stands beside Ted’s hospital bed in a dimly lit room at the Ronald Reagan Institute of Supply-Side Economics and Hospital for the Criminally Insane. She turns off the radio and opens a box of spaghetti-to-go, handing it to him. 'Eat this spaghetti, Ted. It'll make you feel a lot better,' she says. Ted sits up slightly, the electrodes still attached to his head. Across the room, a nurse checks an oil dip-stick in another patient’s mouth and a bearded man in rags mutters to himself while chained to the wall. Elaine tells Ted that she is leaving him for Simon. He gags on the spaghetti. She explains she can’t stay with someone who won’t face reality and says it’s best for everyone. She leans in to kiss him, but he turns away. 'No goodbyes, Elaine. Just go,' he says. She flips a switch by the bed, thinking it’s the radio, but it activates the electro-shock machine. Ted’s body jerks violently as she walks out.
related_events: Elaine offers spaghetti to Ted
Elaine confesses she is leaving Ted for Simon
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Ted Refuses Goodbye and Is Shocked
description: Ted turns away as Elaine leans in to kiss him goodbye. She tells him she is leaving him for Simon and says she doesn’t want to hurt him. Ted tells her there will be no goodbyes, only for her to leave. Elaine reaches for the switch by the bed, intending to turn on the radio, but instead activates the electro-shock device. Ted's body jerks violently in convulsions as she walks out of the room.
related_events: Ted refuses Elaine's goodbye kiss
Elaine attempts to turn on radio but activates electro-shock on Ted
Ted experiences convulsions from electro-shock
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Nurse Hands Ted Pills After Payment
description: A nurse in a uniform with 'I (heart) NORMAL' on the back approaches Ted's bed and hands him a set of pills. Just as he is about to take them, she stops him and holds out her hand. Ted looks at her, then pulls out his wallet and counts out $38 in bills, which he hands over. Only after receiving the money does the nurse allow him to take the medication. She moves on without further comment.
related_events: Nurse presents medication to Ted and requests payment
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Nurse Checks Fluids of Patient with Gold Chains
description: A nurse stands over a pale patient wearing multiple gold chains. She pulls a long oil dip-stick from his mouth, examines the fluid on it, wipes it clean, and slides it back into his mouth.
related_events: Nurse extracts and checks fluid from Sammy Davis Junior
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Ted at the Terminal After Elaine's Departure
description: After Elaine leaves, Ted sits at a terminal, rubbing his temples. The room is quiet except for the hum of machinery. His hands move slowly against his head, fingers pressing into his skin as if trying to ease a deep ache. The walls around him are plain, the space dimly lit, the air still.
related_events: Ted rubs his temples after Elaine leaves
related_occasions: Stay At The Ronald Reagan Institute Of Supply-Side Economics And Hospital For The Criminally Insane

name: Stella Pushes Her Father Through the Terminal
description: Stella Barrington pushes her wheelchair-bound father, Dr. Cyrus Barrington, through the crowded terminal. A porter approaches and offers help. Stella declines, saying they have a terrific woman who comes on Thursdays. The porter recognizes Dr. Barrington as the world-renowned agronomist and expresses admiration. Stella acknowledges it is him, then urges her father to keep moving so they can check in. She mutters that he was never appreciated at the Institute. The porter says he is familiar with the Institute. Stella reveals that her father is dying and wants to be buried on Mercury. She continues pushing him through the terminal as another porter approaches the first, asking if that was Dr. Barrington. The first porter confirms it. The second says he isn’t familiar with the work, but his wife is. Stella and Dr. Barrington make their way toward their departure gate.
related_events: Stella Barrington pushes her father through the terminal crowd
First porter offers assistance to Stella and Dr. Barrington
First porter recognizes Dr. Barrington as a renowned agronomist
Stella expresses resentment about her father's lack of appreciation at the Institute
Stella reveals her father's terminal illness and burial wish

name: Porters Recognize Dr. Barrington in Terminal
description: After Stella pushes her father, Dr. Cyrus Barrington, through the terminal crowd, a second porter approaches the first and asks if the man in the wheelchair was Dr. Barrington, the world-renowned agronomist. The first porter confirms it. The second porter says he isn’t familiar with the scientist’s work, but his wife is.
related_events: Second porter inquires about Dr. Barrington's identity
First porter confirms Dr. Barrington's identity to second porter

name: Ted Decides to Stop the Mercury Shuttle
description: Ted stands before the arrivals and departures monitors, his eyes fixed on the display reading "MERCURY SHUTTLE - DEPARTS 6:AM." He mutters to himself, "I have to stop that flight." Without hesitation, he pushes through the crowd, moving past two businessmen adjusting each other's clothes, and heads toward the shuttle gate.
related_events: Ted focuses on Mercury shuttle departure time at monitors
Ted decides to stop the Mercury shuttle flight
Ted pushes through the crowd toward the shuttle gate

name: Ted Witnesses Class Divisions at the Terminal
description: Ted moves through the terminal, passing the First Class ticket line where an agent offers a traveler a choice of lobster or rack of lamb for an in-flight meal. The traveler selects lobster, and the agent throws a live lobster into a steaming cauldron. Further on, in the Second Class line, a traveler in rags is offered a choice between swill and slop, and chooses slop. Ted continues past the No Class line, where travelers wear gaudy double-knit suits, alpine hats, and carry lava lamps and bongo drums. An agent hands one of them a ticket adorned with large foam dice. The disparities in treatment and service are evident as Ted makes his way toward the Information counter.
related_events: First Class ticket agent offers in-flight dinner options to traveler
Traveler selects lobster for in-flight dinner
First Class agent throws lobster into steaming cauldron
Second Class ticket agent offers limited meal options to ragged traveler
Ragged traveler selects slop for in-flight meal
Ted passes through No Class ticket line with eccentric travelers
No Class agent hands ticket with foam dice to traveler

name: Ted Searches for Mission Control Amid Chaotic Terminal Encounters
description: Ted moves through the terminal, asking a First Class ticket agent where mission control is. The agent tells him to go to the information counter without pointing. Ted heads in that direction, passing lines of travelers dressed in rags and others in gaudy suits. At the information counter, a man asks the agent what the fastest animal on earth is. The agent replies, 'The cheetah,' and moves on. A woman asks if she should fake her orgasms. The agent says, 'Yes,' and calls the next person. Three armed, bearded men step up and ask for the flight to Miami. The agent gestures vaguely and tells them it's over there. The men leave, looking confused. Ted steps forward and asks where mission control is. The agent begins to answer, saying 'It's over therrrrrrr,' when an arrow strikes him. He slumps over the counter. Ted stares, then looks directly ahead, frozen.
related_events: Ted asks First Class agent for location of mission control
First Class agent directs Ted to information counter
Ted moves toward information counter after receiving direction
Man at information counter asks fastest animal on earth
Info Agent answers cheetah to animal speed question
Woman asks Info Agent whether to fake orgasms
Info Agent advises woman to fake orgasms
Three armed terrorists ask for direction to Miami flight
Info Agent directs terrorists to Miami flight without indication
Terrorists leave information counter confused
Ted asks Info Agent for location of mission control
Info Agent begins to respond to Ted before being shot
Info Agent is shot with arrow and collapses

name: Businessmen Adjust Tie and Discuss Viatex Deal
description: Ted pushes through the crowd, passing two businessmen. Businessman 1 straightens Businessman 2's tie and hair. 'Don't worry about the Viatex account,' says Businessman 1. 'It's a buy-sell option. We can't get hurt in either case.' 'Just keep on top of their legal people, Bob,' replies the other. 'Don't sweat it. They kiss and part.'
related_events: Businessman 1 adjusts Businessman 2's appearance
Businessmen discuss the Viatex account strategy

name: Ted's Warning and Simon's Reprisal
description: Ted, wearing flight coveralls, follows Simon during an operation and points to a section of wiring, insisting it shorts out under high temperatures. Simon brushes him off, saying Ted is overworked and that the wiring meets all safety standards. Ted accuses Simon of spreading rumors about his mental state. A newspaper boy passes by, shouting a headline: 'Shuttle test pilot goes mad!' A technician named Jacobs arrives with flight uniform designs. Simon approves most but angrily rejects studded dog collars, sending Jacobs away. Ted confronts Simon, warning he won't get away with it, then turns and collides with Elaine. She tries to comfort him, asking what's wrong, but he pulls away, telling her to ask Simon. In the background, a worker connects jumper cables from a car to a large rocket engine beneath a sign reading 'ROCKET ENGINE TEST AREA.' Elaine urges Ted to rest, suggesting a quiet dinner. Ted snaps at her, claiming everyone is against him, and grabs design plans from a passing technician, shouting that the evidence is in the specifications. Simon signals two guards, who seize Ted. As Ted struggles and rants, a doctor in a white coat injects him in the arm. Elaine cries out, 'No! Wait! You're hurting him!' Ted collapses unconscious.
